sources.title: 東京大学東洋文化研究所図書室：特別貴重書・貴重書閲覧/複写申請、個人郵送不可、線装本複写制限
sources.provider: University of Tokyo Institute for Advanced Studies on Asia (IOC) Library, first-party
sources.quality_notes: The IOC Library application page provides special-rare-book reading/copy forms, requires advance application for rare-book services, ordinarily uses available microfilm/book surrogates first, explicitly excludes postal copying for individuals, and accepts applications by email/post/fax. Separate first-party copy guidance excludes thread-bound Chinese books from self-service photocopiers; publication/reuse licensing is a separate request. This does not prove eligibility, digitization, source-image availability, target folio location, fees or permission for either Oki 1827 item6403767830 or Kuraishi 1869 item6403148395. No application was submitted.
